quote: As of June 2026, cumulative investments totaled COP 3.1 trillion, representing a 16% increase compared to the first six months of 2025. … We also invested COP 3.1 trillion during the period, up 16% from the same period in 2025 … With the investments made during the quarter, ISA's total capex for 2026 reached COP 3.1 trillion, representing a 16% increase compared to the first half of 2025.
note: Opened ISA Q2 2026 English financial results; COP 3.1tn 1H26 / +16% confirmed.
